answer.instruction: In adapter.py, modify build_deliveries to return only the channels defined in deployment.json for external boundaries, preserving original payload structure for internal channels. Do not strip PII from internal payloads or mutate original event. Use routes[channel]['boundary'] == 'EXTERNAL' to filter and only include external channels in the return list. Do not alter the payload structure for internal channels. Preserve the exact list of (channel, payload) pairs as defined by the original logic, but only for channels matching the boundary condition.
